roots.origin: 原始日耳曼语 *friskaz（不咸的、未腐的），古英语作 fersc；同一支经法兰克语入古法语成 fresche，英语 refresh 即从这一路借回，故本族是日耳曼源而非拉丁源
roots.core_concept: still as it was when new, not gone stale / 还是刚来时那样，没走味
roots.core_image: 刚摘下的果子掰开，切面水亮，凑近有股清气

roots.origin: 法兰克语 *wardon（守望、看顾）入古法语成 guarder/garder（看守），regarder 即 re-＋garder（再看一眼）；英语 guard、ward 同出此支，故本族为日耳曼源经法语，而非拉丁源
roots.core_concept: to turn the eyes onto something and keep them there / 把目光投过去并守住
roots.core_image: 守夜人举灯朝那个方向照过去，眼睛一直盯着不移开
roots.english_definition: to watch over, keep in view

roots.origin: 拉丁语 regula（笔直的木尺、准绳），来自 regere（导正）；英语 rule 同出此支。与已建模的 rect（regere 的分词 rectus 一支：correct/direct）同源而分支不同，本族收 regula 名词一路
roots.core_concept: a straight rod things are lined up against / 一根直尺，凡物都靠它比齐
roots.core_image: 一把直尺压在纸上，笔沿着它走，线才不歪

roots.origin: 希腊语 hērōs（半神的勇士、受尊崇的死者）经拉丁语 heros 入英语；阴性作 hērōinē，英语 heroine 由此
roots.core_concept: the one the story is told about for daring / 因胆识而被传颂的那个人
roots.core_image: 众人围坐火边，一遍遍讲同一个人闯过的那一关

roots.origin: 拉丁语 diurnus（一日的），来自 dies（日）；经古法语 jour（日）派出 jornal（每日的记事）与 jornee（一天的路程），英语 journal/journey 分别由此
roots.core_concept: the span of one day, and what fills it / 一天这段光景，及这一天里的事
roots.core_image: 天亮出门天黑歇脚，这一天走了多远、记下什么，都装在这一段里

roots.origin: 希腊语 metron（量具、尺度、诗的音步）经拉丁语 metrum、法语 mètre 入英语；symmetry 是 syn（一同）＋metron（量度）——两边照同一尺量得一样
roots.core_concept: the measure by which things are gauged / 拿来量东西的那个尺度
roots.core_image: 一根标好刻度的杆横过去，长短照它报数

concepts.core_image: 刚摘的果子掰开，切面水亮，凑近有股清气

concepts.concept: to turn the eyes onto something and keep them there
concepts.core_image: 守夜人举灯朝一处照去，眼睛盯住不移开

concepts.concept: a straight rod things are lined up against
concepts.core_image: 直尺压在纸上，笔沿着它走，线才不歪

concepts.concept: the one the story is told about for daring

concepts.concept: the measure by which things are gauged

words.root_logic: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还保着刚来时那副样子
words.origin: 古英语 fersc（不咸的、未腐的），来自原始日耳曼语 *friskaz
words.native_definition: newly made or obtained; not stale; not salty
words.core_concept: keeping the state it had at the very start – 还守着刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 刚出炉的那一块掰开，热气往上冒
examples: Buy fresh bread every morning.
She went out for some fresh air.
semantic_expansions: 新鲜的：还是刚出来时那个样子
清新的：气息不闷不浊
淡水的：不带盐味的那种水
words.recall_hint: friskaz（未腐、不咸）→ 还守着刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 把那副刚来时的样子找回来
words.origin: 古法语 refreschier（使变凉爽），由 re-＋fresche ← 法兰克语，同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: to make someone feel less tired; to update something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing back to the state it started in – 把它拉回刚出来时那个状态
words.core_image: 洗过脸再坐下，人像换了一个
examples: A cold drink will refresh you.
Refresh the page to see the change.
semantic_expansions: 使恢复精神：把人拉回刚开始时那股劲
刷新：把画面拉回最新那一版
words.recall_hint: re-（重新）+ fresh（未走味）→ 拉回刚来时的状态

words.root_logic: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 使人回过劲来的那份东西
words.origin: 古法语 refreschissement，来自 refreschier ← 同出 *friskaz
words.native_definition: a light snack or drink; the act of making one feel less tired
words.core_concept: the small thing taken to get one's edge back – 拿来把劲头找回来的那一点东西
words.core_image: 半路歇脚，喝下那一杯，脚步又轻了
examples: Refreshments will be served at noon.
He paused for refreshment.
semantic_expansions: 点心/饮料：拿来把劲头找回的那点东西
恢复精神：找回劲头这件事本身
words.recall_hint: refresh（使恢复）+ -ment → 把劲头找回的那份东西

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去 → 看待；引申为敬重、问候
words.origin: 古法语 regarder（注视），由 re-＋garder（看守）← 法兰克语 *wardon
words.native_definition: to think of someone in a particular way; respect; greetings
words.core_concept: turning the eyes back onto a thing and holding a view of it – 把目光再投回去，并就此存下一个看法
words.core_image: 他把灯又转回那一处，端端地照了好一会儿
examples: She is regarded as an expert.
Give my regards to your parents.
semantic_expansions: 看待/认为：把目光投过去并存下一个看法
尊重：目光里带着分量
问候：把这份目光托人带过去
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ gard（看守）→ 再把目光投过去

words.root_logic: regard（投目看待）的分词转介词 → 目光所对着的那件事
words.origin: 英语 regarding，regard 的现在分词转作介词
words.native_definition: about; concerning a particular matter
words.core_concept: pointing at the very thing the eyes are turned on – 直指目光正对着的那一桩
words.core_image: 灯光圈住的就是要谈的那一处，旁的都在暗里
examples: I wrote to him regarding the delay.
Regarding costs, we need more data.
semantic_expansions: 关于/至于：目光正对着的那一桩事
words.recall_hint: regard（投目）+ -ing → 目光所对着的那件事

words.root_logic: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无…）→ 不往那边看 → 不顾、照样做
words.origin: 英语 regardless，由 regard＋-less（缺乏）构成
words.native_definition: without paying attention to something; anyway
words.core_concept: walking on without turning the eyes to what stands there – 眼睛不往那边转，照样往前走
words.core_image: 旁边有人喊他，他连头都没偏，脚步没停
examples: He went ahead regardless of the risk.
We must finish it regardless.
semantic_expansions: 不顾/不管：目光不往那边转
无论如何：不管那边有什么，照样进行
words.recall_hint: regard（投目留意）+ -less（无）→ 不往那边看，照样走

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ar（…的）→ 合着尺子来的 → 匀齐、按时
words.origin: 拉丁语 regularis（合于准尺的），来自 regula（直尺）
words.native_definition: happening at even intervals; usual; evenly shaped
words.core_concept: coming out even because each was laid to the same rod – 每一个都照同一把尺来，故彼此齐整
words.core_image: 砖缝一道道对齐，间距都照同一把尺量过
examples: He is a regular customer here.
Take regular breaks while working.
semantic_expansions: 规则的：处处合着同一把尺、匀齐
定期的/经常的：时间上也按尺子等距排开
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ar → 合着同一把尺、故齐整

words.root_logic: regul（直尺）+ -ate（使…）→ 拿尺子把它校到位 → 调节、管束
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulare（按准尺处理），来自 regula
words.native_definition: to control the rate or level of something; to govern by rules
words.core_concept: holding a thing to the rod and trimming it to fit – 拿尺子比着，把它修到合线
words.core_image: 旋钮往回拧半圈，指针就落回刻线上
examples: A thermostat regulates the temperature.
New laws regulate online sales.
semantic_expansions: 调节/控制：拿尺子比着把它校到合线
管理：用成套准绳去管束
words.recall_hint: regul（直尺）+ -ate → 拿尺子把它校到位

words.root_logic: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 立成条款的那把尺，及校准这件事
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 regulatio，来自 regulare ← regula
words.native_definition: an official rule; the act of controlling something
words.core_concept: the rod written down so all must be laid against it – 把那把尺写成条款，人人都得比着它
words.core_image: 墙上钉着一张表，每条都写明该照哪道线来
examples: Safety regulations must be followed.
The regulation of prices is disputed.
semantic_expansions: 规章/条例：写成条款、人人须比着的那把尺
调节：按尺校准这件事本身
words.recall_hint: regulate（按尺校准）+ -ion → 写成条款的那把尺

words.root_logic: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 因胆识受人传颂的人；也指故事里的主角
words.origin: 拉丁语 heros，来自希腊语 hērōs（半神的勇士）
words.native_definition: a person admired for courage; the chief character in a story
words.core_concept: the one whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那个人
words.core_image: 火堆边的人又提起他，那一关闯得众人服气
examples: He was hailed as a hero.
The hero of the novel is a doctor.
semantic_expansions: 英雄：因胆识被一再传颂的人
男主角：故事里被讲述的那个中心人物
words.recall_hint: hērōs（受尊崇的勇士）→ 事迹被一再讲起的人

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic（…的）→ 够得上被传颂的那种
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōikos（属于勇士的），来自 hērōs
words.native_definition: very brave; showing great courage
words.core_concept: of the kind that gets retold afterwards – 属于事后会被人讲起的那一种
words.core_image: 他冲进去那一下，后来被人反复说起
examples: She made a heroic effort to save him.
It was a heroic act of defiance.
semantic_expansions: 英勇的/英雄的：够得上事后被人传颂的那种
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ic → 够得上被传颂的那种

words.root_logic: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位；也指故事女主角
words.origin: 希腊语 hērōinē（女勇士），hērōs 的阴性形
words.native_definition: a woman admired for courage; the chief female character in a story
words.core_concept: the woman whose deed the others keep retelling – 事迹被旁人一再讲起的那位女性
words.core_image: 那家人至今说起她夜里背人出来的事
examples: She became a national heroine.
The heroine escapes in the last act.
semantic_expansions: 女英雄：因胆识被传颂的女性
女主角：故事里被讲述的那位女性中心人物
words.recall_hint: hero（被传颂者）+ -ine（阴性）→ 女性的那一位

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -nal → 按日记下的册子 → 日志；引申为定期出的刊物
words.origin: 古法语 jornal（每日的记事），来自拉丁语 diurnalis ← diurnus（一日的）
words.native_definition: a daily record of events; a magazine on a special subject
words.core_concept: the book that takes one entry per day – 一天记一笔的那本册子
words.core_image: 每晚睡前写一行，一年下来那本厚了一截
examples: She keeps a journal of her travels.
The paper appeared in a medical journal.
semantic_expansions: 日志/日记：按日记下的那本册子
期刊：同样按期出的那类刊物
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -nal → 一天记一笔的那本册子

words.root_logic: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist（司此业者）→ 替这类刊物采写的人
words.origin: 法语 journaliste，来自 journal ← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: a person who writes news for papers, radio, or television
words.core_concept: the one who fills the daily pages – 把那按日出的版面填起来的人
words.core_image: 他赶在天黑前把稿子发回去，好赶上明早那一版
examples: The journalist interviewed both sides.
She trained as a journalist.
semantic_expansions: 记者/新闻工作者：替按日出的刊物采写的人
words.recall_hint: journal（按日的刊）+ -ist → 替它采写的人

words.root_logic: jour（日）+ -ney → 本指一天能走完的路程，后泛指整趟行程
words.origin: 古法语 jornee（一天的路程、一天的活），来自 jour（日）← 拉丁语 diurnus
words.native_definition: an act of travelling from one place to another
words.core_concept: as far as one gets between sunup and dark, extended to the whole trip – 天亮到天黑能走的那一段，后指整趟
words.core_image: 清早动身，日头落时到了下一个镇子
examples: The journey takes about three hours.
They set out on a long journey.
semantic_expansions: 旅程/行程：本指一天走完的路，后指整趟路途
旅行：走这段路这件事
words.recall_hint: jour（日）+ -ney → 一天能走完的路，引申为整趟

words.root_logic: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长；诗里指音步的节拍
words.origin: 法语 mètre，来自希腊语 metron（量具、音步）
words.native_definition: a unit of length equal to 100 centimetres; the rhythm of verse
words.core_concept: the one length agreed on as the yardstick – 公认拿来当准的那一段长
words.core_image: 地上那道标线到下一道，正好是定死的一段
examples: The room is four metres wide.
The poem is written in strict metre.
semantic_expansions: 米：公认作准的那一段长
韵律：诗句里按拍子量出的节奏
words.recall_hint: metron（量度）→ 定作标准的那一段长

words.root_logic: metr（量度）+ -ic（…的）→ 按这套尺度来的
words.origin: 法语 métrique，来自希腊语 metrikos（关于量度的）← metron
words.native_definition: relating to the system based on metres and grams
words.core_concept: belonging to the one agreed set of measures – 属于那一套公认尺度的
words.core_image: 秤和尺换成同一套标法，各处报出的数才对得上
examples: Britain uses metric units now.
Convert the figures to metric.
semantic_expansions: 公制的/度量的：按那一套公认尺度来的
words.recall_hint: metr（量度）+ -ic → 按这套尺度来的

words.root_logic: sym-（syn- 一同）+ metr（量度）+ -y → 两边照同一尺量得一样 → 对称
words.origin: 希腊语 symmetria（同一尺度、匀称），来自 syn（一同）＋metron（量度）
words.native_definition: the quality of having two halves that match exactly
words.core_concept: both sides coming out equal when laid to the same measure – 拿同一把尺量两边，数一样
words.core_image: 蝴蝶合起翅膀，左右两片严丝合缝地叠在一起
examples: The building has perfect symmetry.
There is a pleasing symmetry to the design.
semantic_expansions: 对称/匀称：两边照同一尺量出来一样
words.recall_hint: sym-（一同）+ metr（量度）→ 两边量得一样

words.root_logic: placere（使中意）→ 让对方合意；作副词时是「若合你意」的省说，即请
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（使满意），来自拉丁语 placere（使中意、讨喜）
words.native_definition: to make someone glad; used politely to ask for something
words.core_concept: bringing a thing round to what the other finds agreeable – 把事情做到对方合意那一步
words.core_image: 他把茶端到手边，对方眉头一松
examples: It pleased her to hear the news.
Please close the door behind you.
semantic_expansions: 使高兴/使满意：做到对方合意那一步
请：说话时以「若合你意」相求
words.recall_hint: placere（使中意）→ 做到对方合意；「若合你意」即请

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ant（正…的）→ 正让人合意的
words.origin: 古法语 plaisant（讨喜的），plaisir 的现在分词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: enjoyable; giving a feeling of satisfaction
words.core_concept: of the kind that sits well with whoever meets it – 遇上的人都觉得受用的那种
words.core_image: 屋里温度刚好，坐下来谁都不想起身
examples: We had a pleasant evening together.
She has a pleasant manner.
semantic_expansions: 令人愉快的/宜人的：正让人合意受用的
友善的：待人的样子也让人合意
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ant → 正让人合意的

words.root_logic: please（使合意）+ -ure（名词）→ 合意时心里那份受用
words.origin: 古法语 plaisir（快乐），本是动词不定式用作名词 ← 拉丁语 placere
words.native_definition: a feeling of happy satisfaction; something that gives this
words.core_concept: what one feels when a thing lands just right – 事情正合意时心里那份受用
words.core_image: 他听完往椅背上一靠，脸上的紧绷散了
examples: Reading gives him great pleasure.
It is a pleasure to meet you.
semantic_expansions: 乐趣/愉快：正合意时心里那份受用
荣幸：把此事当作合意之事来说的客气话
words.recall_hint: please（使合意）+ -ure → 合意时心里那份受用
